sources.title: All Rational Polytopes are Transportation Polytopes and all Polytopal Integer Sets are Contingency Tables
sources.version: Author-hosted14-page conference/prepublication text; final related paper is SIAM Journal on Optimization17(2006),806–821,doi10.1137/040610623. Final full text not compared.
read_scope: Theorem3 and proof with auxiliary coordinates,PDFpp10–13
sources.access: Full original text through web PDF extraction; direct shell download unavailable due DNS restrictions.
sources.result: Primal-coordinate universality, not a payoff-core/selector-preserving reduction.

sources.title: Universally Balanced Combinatorial Optimization Games
read_scope: Reference network to Kaneko–Wooders1982 and Deng–Ibaraki–Nagamochi1999
sources.access: Full original published PDF through institutional repository and web extraction.
sources.result: Packing/production representation and no-integrality-gap core certificate are classical; theorem does not reduce arbitrary technology to fixed three-sector pair-additive integer data.

sources.title: Convexity of Hypergraph Matching Game
sources.access: Full original proceedings PDF through alternate official IFAAMAS host; initial Liverpool host failed.
sources.result: Strict positive uniform convex games reduce to disjoint hyperedges; no direct anticipation of the overlapping family.

sources.title: Complexity of constructing solutions in the core based on synergies among coalitions
sources.access: Full original published PDF fromCMU; initially guessed author URL failed.
sources.result: Generic synergy representation and core LP are classical. TU hardness gadget includes coalitions of size3m+1 and values6m; it is not a fixed-rank bounded-value representation theorem.

source_network: 2023matching-game survey query lead ->Kumabe–Maehara2020 ->Conitzer–Sandholm2006 andDeng–Ibaraki–Nagamochi1999. Demange–Deng2010 ->Owen1975,Kaneko–Wooders1982; originals outside inspected scope. Universality theorem read directly fromauthor-hosted source.
unfollowed_lead: 1992/1994 metric/perimeter assignment algorithms surfaced; no full-text claim about their precise gadgets is made.
